## app/cli.py

[app/cli.py](../../app/cli.py)

Small operator commands.

Usage::

    python -m app.cli set-staff +2348012345678
    python -m app.cli unset-staff +2348012345678
    python -m app.cli cleanup-community-media --dry-run
    python -m app.cli check-config

Staff accounts can open the document-review queue. These commands provide
operator bootstrap/recovery access to the configured installation. Existing
administrators can separately manage staff access through staff_routes and its
audited staff service. CLI commands must not be run against member data merely
to explore the application; use --help and isolated test fixtures instead.

Application imports: `app.core.config`, `app.core.public_urls`, `app.core.validators`, `app.db.session`, `app.models.recruitment`, `app.models.user`, `app.services.accounts`, `app.services.backups`, `app.services.community`, `app.services.evidence`, `app.services.message_attachments`, `app.services.recruitment`, `app.services.recruitment_indexing`, `app.services.vacancies`, `app.services.vacancy_coverage`, `app.services.vacancy_duplicates`, `app.services.worker_health`, `app.services.worker_runtime`.

## app/core/community_storage.py

[app/core/community_storage.py](../../app/core/community_storage.py)

Controlled local storage for public community images and videos.

Uploads are streamed to an opaque temporary file, validated and optionally
scanned, then atomically renamed. Production should replace this local store
with a dedicated media-processing and object-storage pipeline.

Application imports: `app.core.config`, `app.models.community`.

## app/core/config.py

[app/core/config.py](../../app/core/config.py)

Typed environment configuration and startup validation.

All application settings use the NURSE_NG_ prefix. Production reads process
environment variables, while development may load .env. Settings are cached at
import time: restart web and workers after changing configuration. Validation
rejects unsafe production hosts, origins, cookies and signing keys before serving
traffic. Secret fields must never appear in logs or documentation output.

Application imports: `app.core.public_urls`.

| --- | --- | --- |

## app/core/evidence_validation.py

[app/core/evidence_validation.py](../../app/core/evidence_validation.py)

Parse untrusted documents in a short-lived process with memory and CPU limits.

Invoked by the private evidence store in a disposable process. Resource limits
protect the web process from hostile image/PDF parsers; malware scanning and
reviewer access are separate checks.

## app/core/ratelimit.py

[app/core/ratelimit.py](../../app/core/ratelimit.py)

In-memory fixed-window request limiting.

Used for per-IP throttling of the authentication endpoints. A fixed window
counts events from the first event in the window; when the window elapses the
counter is discarded and starts again.

State is process-local: it resets on restart and is not shared between worker
processes. That is acceptable while the pilot runs one server process; see
DECISIONS L37 for the trade-off and the trigger to move this to Redis or the
database.

## app/core/uuid.py

[app/core/uuid.py](../../app/core/uuid.py)

UUIDv7 generation.

Python 3.14 ships `uuid.uuid7`; use it when available. Otherwise generate an
RFC 9562 UUIDv7 locally.

UUIDv7 is time-ordered, which keeps B-tree inserts sequential while remaining
unguessable. It is the identifier format set out in the build plan.

[app/main.py](../../app/main.py)

## app/models/education.py

[app/models/education.py](../../app/models/education.py)

Education records, hosting permissions, and evidence from the live provider.

Educator approval grants teaching permissions only; it never changes staff
permissions or asserts professional accreditation. Published courses contain
ordered modules and lessons. Enrollment and lesson progress belong to the
learner, while quiz answer keys remain server-side. Session reservations use a
separate counted seat allocation so the service can enforce capacity atomically.

Live attendance and recording metadata are written only after a provider webhook
has been authenticated. Reservations and self-reported lesson completion are not
attendance or accreditation evidence. Recording objects remain private.

## app/models/profile.py

[app/models/profile.py](../../app/models/profile.py)

Nurse profiles, credential claims, and field-level visibility.

Visibility defaults to private. A field is visible only when an explicit
`FieldVisibility` row raises it. Discoverability is opt-in and defaults to
false; nothing here makes a profile public.

`CredentialClaim.status` is a projection of the verification domain. A claim
must never reach `document_reviewed`, `source_confirmed`, or `revoked`
without a corresponding verification decision row (build plan, section 5).
The document-review workflow (DECISIONS L47-L52) records its outcome on
`document_reviewed_at` and does not write credential claims; a claim may only
be raised by a future source-confirmed decision.

## app/services/community.py

[app/services/community.py](../../app/services/community.py)

Community publishing, moderation, and member-relationship rules.

Posts, replies, people follows and accepted connections share this domain.
A follow is not a connection and does not grant private messaging. Public reads
filter current publication/account state; moderation can revoke availability.
Media writes need reconciliation because disk and database commits are separate.

## app/services/community_growth.py

[app/services/community_growth.py](../../app/services/community_growth.py)

Public communities, learning participation and useful-answer recognition.

Joining, Helpful recognition and selected answers are separate records.
Desired-state writes tolerate retries. Membership choices remain private;
recognition is community feedback, not credential verification.

## app/services/community_participation.py

[app/services/community_participation.py](../../app/services/community_participation.py)

Newcomer welcomes, recurring activities and private participation records.

The dashboard reminder is controlled only by MemberJourney.dismissed_at.
Saving with dismiss=False clears dismissal; community progress never auto-hides
it. Introduction publication requires consent at the HTTP boundary and creates
ordinary public content. The notifications worker advances recurring sessions.
See docs/DASHBOARD_ONBOARDING.md and docs/COMMUNITY_PARTICIPATION.md.

## app/services/education.py

[app/services/education.py](../../app/services/education.py)

Education authorization, content editing, progress and live-session lifecycle.

Public services validate member identity and ownership before changing records.
Educator approval is independent of staff access. Courses stay private until
explicitly published with usable lessons; answer keys stay server-side. A seat
reservation is allocated with a conditional database UPDATE, not a count followed
by an insert, which prevents oversubscription when requests race.

`handle_live_webhook` is an internal boundary: callers MUST authenticate the
provider's signature first. Only that boundary creates attendance/recordings.
Provider retries are deduplicated by a receipt in the same transaction. Client
claims of attendance, quiz scores or room permissions are never accepted.

Mutating public functions commit their transaction. Expected validation and
authorization failures raise EducationError; callers should roll back before
rendering their form errors. URLs are external resources, never fetched or stored
as uploads by this module. Completion is learning progress, not accreditation.

## app/services/education_live.py

[app/services/education_live.py](../../app/services/education_live.py)

Managed classroom media, signed attendance events and private recordings.

This module is a transport boundary, not a learner authorization boundary.
Routes MUST first ask `education.join_session`/host authorization whether an
active account may act on a particular session. They then pass that session's
UUID here. Room names are deterministic and namespaced; callers cannot select a
different LiveKit room. Browser grants contain only room-join/subscription and
explicit publishing permissions. Host administration and recording grants are
used only in server-to-server RPCs, never returned to a browser.

LiveKit's webhook JWT signs a SHA-256 digest of the *exact request bytes*.
Re-serializing JSON before verification breaks that binding. `verify_webhook`
checks issuer, algorithm, expiry and constant-time digest equality; the domain
service then records the event ID in its transactional replay receipt. Neither
browser pings nor chat messages establish attendance or completed recordings.

Recordings are written by LiveKit egress into an operator-controlled private
S3-compatible bucket. Completed signed provider events retain an object key.
After rechecking learner access, a route may issue a short-lived signed GET URL.
This module never changes bucket ACLs or accepts user-selected storage origins.
Provider failures are sanitized so bearer grants, API secrets and S3 credentials
cannot reach feedback, logs or rendered error pages.

Application imports: `app.core.config`.

## app/services/education_notifications.py

[app/services/education_notifications.py](../../app/services/education_notifications.py)

Idempotent lecture reminders through the existing notification outbox.

The notification worker calls `queue_learning_reminders` even when SMTP is
disabled, because in-app reminders are useful independently of email. Receipts
use session ID + scheduled start + reminder window; retries cannot create a new
notice for the same learner/window. Changing a schedule therefore creates a new
receipt, while read/email delivery rechecks the current registration and time.
This module queues notices only. The established outbox owns mail delivery.

## app/services/message_attachments.py

[app/services/message_attachments.py](../../app/services/message_attachments.py)

Private staging, bounded upload usage, authorized file access and cleanup.

Files stage privately, validate/scan, then attach to an authorized message.
Ownership, per-file/window quotas and release state are checked server-side.
Maintenance handles unfinished uploads and disk remnants; an opaque filename
by itself never authorizes download. See docs/PRIVATE_MESSAGE_FILES.md.

## app/services/notification_worker.py

[app/services/notification_worker.py](../../app/services/notification_worker.py)

Durable email outbox with expiring claims and bounded retries.

SMTP is at-least-once: a crash after acceptance can result in a duplicate on retry.

## app/services/notifications.py

## app/services/verification.py

[app/services/verification.py](../../app/services/verification.py)

Document-review workflow.

A nurse submits an NMCN (Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria) licence or

the label "document reviewed" only; it never claims source confirmation

## app/services/weekly_digest.py

[app/services/weekly_digest.py](../../app/services/weekly_digest.py)

Opt-in weekly highlights with durable claims and live eligibility checks.

Email requires verified-address opt-in. Receipts are per account/local week,
store no content snapshot, and recheck current membership/content before sending.
Changing preferences cancels queued claims; terminal receipts have bounded
retention. SMTP acceptance followed by a crash can still cause a retry.

## app/services/worker_runtime.py

[app/services/worker_runtime.py](../../app/services/worker_runtime.py)

Recovering worker loops and process supervision with bounded restart delays.

The notifications role also creates opportunity/lecture reminders, publishes
recurring activities, queues digests and maintains private message files. These
in-app jobs run even with mail disabled. Supervision restarts failed/stuck process
groups and reports progress to readiness. See docs/WORKER_OPERATIONS.md.

## app/web/education_classroom_routes.py

[app/web/education_classroom_routes.py](../../app/web/education_classroom_routes.py)

Classroom access, host moderation and authenticated media-provider callbacks.

Browser mutations use the signed-in account and a CSRF header. Provider events
use raw-body JWT verification instead: they have no browser session. Both enter
the same education domain so a client cannot claim attendance, grant itself a
host role, or mark a recording complete. External calls run in a worker thread
and use bounded timeouts; they must not block the ASGI event loop.

Session row locks serialize starts, recording requests and permission changes
on PostgreSQL. Calls create/update the provider room before committing the
matching application state. A provider failure therefore remains visible and
does not produce a fictitious live/recording success state.

Application imports: `app.db.session`, `app.models.education`, `app.models.user`, `app.services`, `app.services.education_notifications`, `app.web.deps`, `app.web.education_common`, `app.web.feedback`.

## app/web/education_common.py

[app/web/education_common.py](../../app/web/education_common.py)

Shared presentation helpers for learning pages and classroom endpoints.

Domain services authorize access before these helpers build template context.
The dictionaries here describe the current database state; they do not grant
permissions, infer attendance from a reservation, or expose quiz answer keys.
Keeping presentation queries here lets route handlers focus on HTTP behavior.
See docs/LIVE_LEARNING_ARCHITECTURE.md for the end-to-end request flows.

## app/web/education_routes.py

[app/web/education_routes.py](../../app/web/education_routes.py)

HTTP pages and authoring forms for courses, educators and live lectures.

Routes adapt browser input to the education domain; the domain owns validation,
ownership, seat accounting and progress. Every mutation requires a current
account and CSRF protection. Provider calls are confined to classroom routes.
Ordinary forms keep working without JavaScript, and validation failures retain
the submitted values. No route automatically approves an educator or publishes
invented content. See docs/LIVE_LEARNING_ARCHITECTURE.md for the route map.

## app/web/offline_routes.py

[app/web/offline_routes.py](../../app/web/offline_routes.py)

Integrated offline workspace and a neutral, credential-free navigation shell.

The neutral shell contains no account data. Authenticated endpoints expose
a scope for encrypted browser records and validate supported queued operations.
A pending local action is never presented as a confirmed server write.
